learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to smile, say hello, and greet our friends and family every day!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When the sun comes up, a new day begins! We smile and say Good Morning to everyone at home.
When the moon and stars come out, it is dark outside. We say Good Night before we go to sleep.
When a friend shares a toy, it makes us very happy. We always smile and say Thank You to be good friends.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Magic Mirror Game
fun_activity.instructions: Stand in front of a big mirror and show your best smile! Wave your hand and practice saying Good Morning and Hello to yourself.

quick_recap: ⭐ We say Good Morning when we wake up.
⭐ We say Good Night when it is time to sleep.
⭐ We say Thank You when someone helps us.
